title: QUDIT-CUBE: explicit fine vectors at cube-root sample depth

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and secret s,n=ceil(log2N),the single QUDIT-CUBE algorithm in proof.md and qudit_decoder.md recovers the entire secret with unconditional success>=1-2^-8 on independent ideal copies. Below n=2^48 it uses the fully specified prefetched fixed-block exhaustive branch k=n+10; uniform absolute outer constants include its bank storage. Main m is the least positive integer withm^3>=n,u=ceil(log2n),kappa=ceil(log2m)+1,s0=kappa+1,base=ceil(n/(m+1)-m/2)+1,dl=base+s0,H=base+m-1,L=floor(m/(4s0)),nonroot widths base+i+min(s0,floor((m-1-i)s0/L)). Rootwidth is1 forcoarse,r=ceil(log2(n^5)) forfine. Set Kc=8192(m+10u+100),Kp=8192(u+100),Ct=65536dl2^m,Y=ceil(log2Ct),E=4u,Lblk=ceil(n/floor(log2n)),A=4Lblk,Qcap=Ct*(Kc*(Y+6+E)+A)+Kp. Each root costsatmostCt selectedsourcecalls; coarsemissingrecordsscorezero. Fine rootsretrymissing underONEglobal attemptcapA,and a completedvector is measured by explicitly enumerated frequency-bin compression,controlleduniform-rank unpreparation and inverseFourier with chargedClifford+T synthesis. Extra4u coarsestages bound residualphase; pairwise frequencydifferenceuniformity gives the every-secret fineblock bound. The exact binary/radix/high-part instruments andsignedodd/two-adic decoder are reproduced. Eachselecteddelivery uses1024 rawideal copies withcoreidle,then10 fairbitschooseone; unchosen/paddingcopies count,actualQ=1024Qcap fixed. NoQRAM,subset-sum orrotationoracle is supplied. Everyerror,retry,discard,missingroot,globalcapabort,lookup,address,sourcecharge,synthesis,circuitgeneration andcleanup is charged. All four worst-case envelopes hold jointly on EVERYbranch; F(n)=n^(2/3)-(1/2)n^(1/3) retains its negative term. Resource logarithms usepositive n=2 values atn=1. Total charged work O((n^(10/3)/log2n)2^F(n)),exact growth index2/3.
